title: Finite A0 equivalence and counterexample replay
statement: Axeyum checks the Chapter 11 clear-register pair under result-only and complete-state observations and replays canonical decoded-state counterexamples through both encoded programs.

formal.statement: enumerate declared width-8 initial states; execute movi r0,0 and xor r0,r0,r0; compare named observations; decode and replay every satisfying mismatch model

scope: Width eight, one-step programs, all 256 r0 values and all 16 initial condition assignments in the unrestricted family, with other registers zero, empty memory, pc zero, and running outcome; the exact condition premise narrows the full-state family to 256 states.

evidence.note: The destination mutation returns a complete canonical state model whose r0 mismatch replays. The unrestricted full-state query separately returns a carry-only witness.

axeyum.route: finite A0 equivalence and decoded-model replay
